prompt: Photorealistic studio product rendering, true side elevation of integrated wheeled drum rover doing rear high-lift dump. Long low chassis about knee-high, about twice as long as tall, riding on four large spiked grouser steel wheels, two visible in profile, front pair at left, rear pair at right, sitting on a thin cut-off patch of dark loose granular simulant soil that ends cleanly at a plain seamless light-grey studio backdrop with soft product lighting. At front left, transverse steel digging drum mounted low between front wheels, teeth engaged in a small soil pile and shallow cut groove. Mid-chassis rectangular frame with battery box and electronics box slung low. Tall slender folding perception mast rising vertically near front third, topped with cameras and antenna, about head-high on the machine. At rear right, vertical rear high-lift mast as a straight chain-driven slide guide with twin actuator cylinders and roller chain and sprockets visible, fully extended, carrying a large steel tilting hopper on top tipped rearward beyond the wheels, pouring a visible continuous stream of dark soil down into a standard plastic tote collection bin placed behind the rover for scale. Hopper overhangs behind rear axle, pour lip well above the bin. Show steel as painted and bare metal, rubber-free rigid wheels with triangular grousers, fabric hopper interior with soil load. Fixed vs moving readable: chassis and masts fixed, wheels and drum rotating, lift slider extended, hopper tilted. Material flow visible front to rear: cut soil at drum to hopper to falling stream to bin. Add short callouts with thin leader lines for each focus part, clean legible text on small light tags placed in empty space, no other text in image.
must_not: room interiors landscapes sky and vegetation
extra vehicles and extra scale figures
hand sketch styling arrows and dimension lines
large text blocks margins and scale bars
changes_from_previous: Initial rendering - no previous version, new side-view dump moment from sketches.

visual_plan.spatial_layout: Side view, left to right: digging drum low at front between front wheels, grouser wheels fore and aft under chassis, perception mast vertical mid-front, low chassis with boxes center, rear lift mast vertical over rear wheels, tilted hopper high above and slightly behind rear, soil stream falling to tote bin at far right on same soil patch; light-grey seamless backdrop all around; bin provides known-size scale next to waist-high lift.
visual_plan.operating_moment: Deployed high-lift dump moment: rover stationary nose-down stable, front drum in soil cut, perception mast fully raised, rear mast fully extended with hopper raised and tipped pouring soil stream into collection bin full of soil behind.
visual_plan.transfer_path: Load: soil from drum cut into hopper, hopper weight up rear lift mast via chain into chassis into wheels to ground, then tipped pour into bin; Measured: cameras and motion sensor on mast to onboard computer via radio heartbeat for stop-hold remote operation.
visual_plan.interactions: Front drum teeth bite shallow cut and throw soil toward central hopper path; chassis carries mast loads down into four grouser wheels pressing into simulant; rear mast chain slide lifts and supports tilted hopper; hopper lip pours soil stream into tote bin; perception mast stands fixed while cameras look forward over drum.
avoid: stowed flat transport pose inside start box
linkage or hydraulic arm replacing vertical chain slide
hopper hidden inside chassis or level carry pose
drum hidden behind wheels or replaced by blade

focus_parts.purpose: Raise hopper on chain slide to pour lip
Carry soil and tip to dump into bin
Shallow cut and lift soil to hopper
Hold cameras high for remote view
